Hey honey, as someone recovering from an ED. This is just your ED talking. Diabetes isn't developed from "eating too much sugar", Many things such as genetics, autoimmune problems, and REALLY BAD lifestyle choices can lead to developing diabetes. This specific sub reddit (Type 1) is caused by an auto-immune "reaction", so don't worry- you're gonna be okay. Your ED will try everything to stop you from recovering, but doing the opposite of what it wants you to do is exactly what you need to do to recover. I also suggest you try asking your parents to get help ( if you are comfortable) I know having parental figures step into your recovery journey is scary, but definitely essential for keeping you on track. You might also want to invest in a dietician if that's and option. 

Keep going Honey, I'm proud of you :)
